title: Syntax highlighting
brief: Tree-sitter token colors per surface with bolt's syntax roles plus a new property role for keys: response body, raw body editor, GraphQL, scripts, Generate code, Document layout; dark and light.

artboards.title: Token colors
artboards.tradeoff: One role set on every surface, so read and typed JSON match; GraphQL query, Go and .http lines stay plain until their grammars exist
